'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[2021 evacuation of Afghanistan]]
***[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
****The [[Embassy of the United States, Kabul|U.S. Embassy in Kabul]] warns [[Americans]] to leave the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]] in [[Kabul]] due to a "specific, credible threat". Additionally, [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Joe Biden]] issues a warning of another attack on the airport in the next "24–36 hours". [https://www.businessinsider.com/us-warns-citizens-of-a-credible-threat-near-kabul-airport-2021-8 (Business Insider)]
***[[Operation Pitting]]
****[[British Armed Forces|British troops]] return to the [[United Kingdom]] from [[Afghanistan]], ending the evacuation process at the airport and the country's involvement in [[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|the war]]. [https://time.com/6093562/kabul-uk-evacuation/ (Time)]
**[[LGBT]] organization [[Rainbow Railroad]] says that it has received hundreds of requests for help, mainly from Afghan gay men. Exiled Afghan LGBT activist [[Nemat Sadat]] warned last week that under the [[Taliban]], [[homosexual]] men will be hunted down. Sadat says that he alone has received over 250 requests from Afghan gay men requesting help in order to leave the country. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/lgbtq-afghanistan-taliban-escape-1.6155999 (CBC)]
**Co-leader of the [[National Resistance Front of Afghanistan]] and self-proclaimed [[President of Afghanistan|president]] [[Amrullah Saleh]] criticizes the United States for [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|its withdrawal]] and for its demand last year of releasing Taliban prisoners as part of [[Doha Agreement (2020)|the negotiations]]. Saleh says that the Taliban's rule "won't last long" and appeals to the [[European Union]] for support. [https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/610321/World/Asia/Taliban-rule-wont-last-long-claims-Afghanistans-self-declared-acting-president (Saudi Gazette)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Ida]] moves toward the coast of the [[U.S. state]] of [[Louisiana]] as a potential Category 4, after impacting [[Cuba]] yesterday. The storm is strengthening in the [[Gulf of Mexico]] and is expected to reach [[New Orleans]] on Sunday. Mayor [[LaToya Cantrell]] orders centralized evacuations in the city. [https://apnews.com/article/new-orleans-storms-hurricanes-tropical-storms-science--d4b3399437cc5ccb7e76aa270a63f724 (Associated Press)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/08/28/weather/hurricane-ida-saturday/index.html (CNN)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Japan]]
*****The [[Japan]]ese [[Ministry of Health, Labour, and Welfare|health ministry]] confirms that two men died after receiving their second dose of the contaminated [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]] from one of three manufacturers. The ministry said that the cause of the deaths was still being investigated. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/japan-probes-two-deaths-after-jabs-from-tainted-moderna-batch (Radio France Internationale)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 19,441 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1,935,700. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/08/28/21/new-record-philippines-logs-19441-more-covid-19-cases (ABS-CBN News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] receives a shipment of 300,000 doses of the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] donated from [[China]]'s [[People's Liberation Army]]. [https://www.dailynews.lk/2021/08/28/local/257855/defence-secretary-received-300000-sinopharm-vaccine-doses-china (Daily News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[Italy|Italian]] [[Ministry of Health (Italy)|Ministry of Health]] announces that beginning from August 31, fully vaccinated British travellers will be able to scrap the five-day self-quarantine if they show a proof of negative [[Polymerase chain reaction|PCR]] and [[Antigen]] [[COVID-19 testing|test]] in the previous 48 hours and must have been at least 14 days after receiving a second dose of the COVID-19 vaccine. [https://news.sky.com/story/amp/covid-19-italy-to-scrap-quarantine-for-fully-vaccinated-travellers-from-uk-12393751 (Sky News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kosovo]]
****[[Kosovo]] reimposes its nightly [[curfew]] from 10:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. and delays the start of the school year until September 13 due to a worsening COVID-19 situation in the country. Only essential staff will be allowed to work in public and private institutions until September 13. [https://politiko.al/english/kosova/kosova-ben-hapa-prapa-shtyhet-viti-shkollor-dhe-rikthehet-ora-policore-ma-i442301 (Politiko)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]]
****[[New South Wales]] reports a record 1,035 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-08-28/nsw-records-1035-locally-acquired-covid-19-cases/100415104 (ABC News Australia)]
